verdict.rationale: Letta is a stateful-agent and memory platform, so asking whether it plugs memory into real-time voice pipelines is a fair question. The evidence pack documents no integration with LiveKit, Pipecat, ElevenLabs, or any other voice framework, and makes no latency claims suited to live conversation. The streaming SDK, Slack integration, and ACP/OpenAI-compatible APIs are adjacent building blocks, not documented voice integrations, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can wire memory into real-time voice pipelines (e.g. LiveKit, Pipecat, ElevenLabs) with documented integrations fast enough for live conversation
